description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a Calculator class for basic arithmetic operations, including digit input, operations, equals, clear, backspace, and error handling.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A class providing a simple sequential-evaluation calculator for basic arithmetic operations with state management for display, history, and error handling.

methods.name: inputDigit
methods.description: Handles input of a digit character, updating the current input and display accordingly.

methods.name: inputDot
methods.description: Handles input of a decimal point, appending it to the current number if not already present.

methods.name: applyOp
methods.description: Applies an arithmetic operation to the current input, updating accumulator and history.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Performs the calculation based on the current accumulator, operator, and input, updating the display and resetting relevant state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the calculator to the initial state, clearing display, history, and error flags.

methods.name: backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the current input, resetting to '0' if empty.

methods.name: buildHistory
methods.description: Constructs the history string based on the accumulator and operator.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the calculator state to error, updating display and resetting values.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs the arithmetic operation between two doubles, returns null on division by zero or invalid operator.

methods.name: stripTrailingZeros
methods.description: Removes trailing zeros and decimal point from a double's string representation.
